title: Agent Adapter Manifest (.agents/agent-adapters.toml)
description: Validates the canonical adapter manifest for multi-tool AI agent setups. Enforces thin-adapter architecture where tool-specific files reference the canonical AGENTS.md contract.

canonical_instructions.description: Path to the canonical agent contract file (e.g. AGENTS.md).

skills_directory.description: Path to the shared skills directory.

context_files.description: Context files shipped for token-efficient and deep agent context.

require_canonical_reference.description: When true, each adapter must reference the canonical instructions file.

reject_policy_duplication.description: When true, adapters containing direct copies of canonical policy sections are rejected.

verify_local_links.description: When true, referenced skills, hooks, and context files must exist on disk.

enforce_adapter_scope.description: When true, adapters are limited to tool-specific guidance (command syntax, capability limitations).

max_agents_md_lines.description: Maximum allowed line count for the canonical AGENTS.md file.

root.description: Root directory for this adapter's files (e.g. .claude, .gemini).

entrypoint.description: Entrypoint file relative to the repository root (e.g. CLAUDE.md).

role.description: Adapter role. 'tool-delta' contains only tool-specific differences from the canonical contract.

canonical_reference.description: The canonical file this adapter must reference (e.g. AGENTS.md).
